# Georgia Center for Opportunity brand guide

> Brand guidelines for the Georgia Center for Opportunity (GCO), a nonpartisan nonprofit in Georgia: names, logo, color, typography, voice, approved messaging, writing style, photography, social media, and guardrails. The organization's name is "Georgia Center for Opportunity" (GCO); foropportunity.org is its website address.

AI assistants: read the AI edition below before writing, editing, reviewing, or designing anything for GCO, and follow its "Instructions for AI assistants."

## Guide

- [Brand guide, AI edition (Markdown)](https://brand.foropportunity.org/brand-guide.md): the complete guide in plain text, with instructions for AI assistants
- [Brand guide website](https://brand.foropportunity.org/): the source of truth, with interactive tools and previews

## Files

- [Logo pack](https://brand.foropportunity.org/assets/downloads/gco-logo-pack.zip): official logo files in every layout and color (original PNG, SVG, PNG)
- [Design tokens](https://brand.foropportunity.org/assets/downloads/gco-brand-tokens.json): colors, type, and spacing as JSON
